relationships.subject: Paeonol + glycyrrhizic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: RNA-Seq experiments revealed that PAE + GLY upregulated the expression of Glutamate decarboxylase 2 (GAD2) and γ-aminobutyric acid type B receptor subunit 2 (GABBR2) genes.

relationships.subject: Paeonol + glycyrrhizic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Further validation demonstrated an increase in γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) content in cerebrospinal fluid post PAE + GLY treatment

relationships.subject: Paeonol + glycyrrhizic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Consequently, this inhibited the expression of dural cAMP-dependent protein kinase catalytic subunit alpha (PRKACA) and transient receptor potential channel type 1 (TRPV1)

key_findings: PAE + GLY reduced CGRP and migraine-like behaviours in nitroglycerin-treated rats.
PAE + GLY upregulated GAD2, GABBR2 and TRPM8 and suppressed dural PRKACA and TRPV1.
